notes: Program code PY29. Verified against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/PHYS-ug.html: lower division 52 units, upper division core 33 units, lab 4 units, restricted electives 20 units (total 109). PHYS 4 series is the standard calculus-based intro sequence. Programming requirement is PHYS 41; transfer students may petition an equivalent completed before transfer (CENG/NANO 15, COGS 18, CSE 8A/11/12, ECE 15, MAE 8).

buckets.label: Introductory physics sequence (calculus-based mechanics through modern physics)
buckets.note: All five required (20 units). Confirmed: 'PHYS 4A-B-C-D-E (twenty units)'.

buckets.label: Computing / programming requirement
buckets.note: PHYS 41 (four units). Transfer students may petition an equivalent completed before transfer: CENG 15, NANO 15, COGS 18, CSE 8A, CSE 11, CSE 12, ECE 15, or MAE 8.

buckets.label: Mathematics sequence (calculus, linear algebra, vector calculus)
buckets.note: All six required (24 units). Confirmed: 'MATH 18 and 20A-B-C-D-E'. Honors equivalents MATH 31AH/31BH/31CH may substitute per department.

buckets.label: Upper-division laboratory
buckets.note: Choose one (4 units). Confirmed: 'One from PHYS 122, 124, 133, 173, or ASTR 150'.

buckets.label: Restricted electives
buckets.note: Five upper-division and/or graduate-level courses from PHYS 100-195 and 200-295 (20 units). Course ranges are placeholders for any qualifying PHYS course in those number bands; a degree audit enumerates the eligible courses.
